created_by: Official Macro Source and Coverage Auditor

official_evidence.fact: The endpoint reports dates when values were revised or newly released and requires an API key.
The endpoint supports real-time periods and explicit vintage dates; the API key is required.
BLS API v1 is keyless and limited; v2 registration increases limits, but API history is not a revision-vintage ledger.
Dated archived Employment Situation releases are listed back through the requested 2000 start and retain superseded values.
Dated archived CPI releases are listed back through the requested 2000 start and warn that later releases may revise data.
Dated archived PPI releases are listed back through the requested 2000 start.
Dated archived JOLTS releases are available; the series begins near the end of 2000.
BEA provides a research archive of dated GDP and Personal Income and Outlays releases; data may be superseded.
The BEA API requires a registered UserID and exposes current published datasets, not a historical revision ledger.
The archive explicitly retains old releases that do not contain the most current data and covers the requested period.
Census lists historical advance durable-goods and full M3 releases plus revision information.
The Board publishes original and subsequent normal-window revisions for industrial production plus dated release archives.
Monthly HTML, PDF, and ASCII G.17 releases cover the requested 2000 start.
A dated 2000 H.15 release preserves daily effective federal funds observations as published.
Dated H.4.1 balance-sheet release pages and files are available, including the 2002 format transition.
RESPPA_N.WW is the stable DDP identity for H.4.1 total assets, in millions of dollars, weekly Wednesday level.
The H.6 release-date index exposes dated releases back through 2000; archived release copies preserve as-published M2 tables.
The public data hub exposes current and historical-search reference-rate and repo-operation data but does not document immutable prior API versions.
The current weekly release preserves advance and revised prior-week values, but this audit did not verify an exhaustive stable 2000-2026 archive index.
